dataset.title: Replication Data for:6D Pose Estimation of Pallet Bins for Autonomous Logistics Using a Synthetically Trained Object Detector and FoundationPose
dataset.affiliation: Associatie KU Leuven; paper: Diepenbeek Campus, ACRO/FlandersMake

license.scope: Official dataset catalog metadata; article license is a separate matter

capture.object: One physical wooden high-sided open-top Pallox pallet BIN, not a flat pallet
capture.mesh: COLMAP reconstruction from multi-view RGB; one physical instance; contents varied in captured bin
capture.camera: Tripod; heights0.55/1.23/1.92m; laboratory artificial light / glass-ceiling hallway natural light
capture.source_pairs: Paper describes unoccluded + cardboard-occluded RGBD capture at each camera position; no filename order guarantee

label_provenance.SAM: Paper describes manual prompt-point selection then SAM. No independent human dense-pixel correction is stated.
label_provenance.mask_zero: Not an independently certified visible-negative, external, self, or outside label
label_provenance.supplied_pose_history: Source authors used manual 2D–3D correspondences with PnP-RANSAC or depth/SVD; this intake only reads provided matrices
label_provenance.pose_direction: README camera-to-object heading conflicts with explicit ob_in_cam equation p_cam=T@p_obj. Direct T projection/depth is substantially better in fixed-six audit.
label_provenance.geometry_limit: Renderer proves implementation/projection consistency, not source mesh or pose physical accuracy
label_provenance.native_RGB_depth_alignment: No explicit source alignment/calibration statement located in README/paper; common native grid is a conditional assumption, not certified pixel GT
